text_block_list.text:
With a number of victories under her
belt, Mejiro
McQueen and I decide to
go out for some tea.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It seems she's made a decision.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: ...That's it. I have made up my mind.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин
choice_data_list:
So you're going to get the Mont Blanc set after
all?

text_block_list.text: I'm not talking about the menu!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Do you recall how I won those hot spring
coupons
in that shopping raffle?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I decided how I'd like to use them, since
I have
been so successful up to this
point.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I think the two people who have made
the biggest
contributions to my success
ought to be the ones
to go. Am I wrong?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I ask her who they might be.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: It was a close call, but in my opinion...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It's the two of us. A reasonable
conclusion, don't
you think?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
As my trainer, you have both the right
and the
obligation to accompany me.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: So, what do you think?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: You'd "love to"?! How direct you are!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
However, that pleases me. It's settled,
then. We
should begin making
preparations soon.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
(I did it... I finally had the courage to
ask!)
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: At last, we reach the hot spring inn.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Soaking in the hot spring...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Um... That was quite a wonderful bath.
Did you
enjoy yourself?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
B-before we go eat, there's something
I'd like to
talk to you about. Um, well...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
It's said that this hot spring is good for
joint pain,
bruises, and cold sensitivity,
among other things.
It also helps
promote beautiful skin.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Long ago in the Edo period, this place
flourished
as an inn town, and many
travelers stopped to
rest here.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Its specialties are hot spring manju and
sweetfish.
In other words, what I want to
talk about...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Is not this.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
A-although I'm glad I came, I don't know
how I
should spend my time here.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: What should I do?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Take it easy?! Under these
circumstances?!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I admire your calm state of mind...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Sigh... I'm no good, am I? I embarked from the Mejiro family home and devoted myself to running, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
One step away from all of that and I
have no clue
what to do with myself.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: It's childish, isn't it? But...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I think the fact that I can tell when I'm
being
childish means that I've grown too!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: You... think so as well, don't you?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Sigh... Maybe it's the blood rushing to my head, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I feel as though I can be completely
honest with
you for the first time, now
that I've come here.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
You're with me, but not as my trainer.
Here, we
don't need to train.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: So, it's nice to meet you, my not-trainer.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
She seems to have relaxed a little. The
light
returns to her eyes.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's have our meal. I shall
take my
time savoring these
scrumptious-looking dishes.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Afterwards, there are many things I want
to talk
about! You'll spend time with me,
of course, won't
you?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
The two of us have lots of fun and lots of
laughs.
We talk animatedly about
nothing in particular
for hours.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I sense that Мэдзиро МакКуин and I have
formed
an irreplaceable bond during this
time together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
